theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_tc_cl_closure_succ
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P d : ℕ), d + 1 < P → (∀ (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity R → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → R.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → IsIntegerMultiplicity R.boundary) → (∀ (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j).boundary) → (∀ j, (Ts j).support ⊆ K) → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).mass + (Ts j).boundary.mass) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) → (∀ (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T)
